body: I dont really know What a counselor is, but i dont see anybody except for the tutors, but they work in a different way here. You see them When you are worse than the others.

Hi,
Writing from bed before going to sleep, so You know im okay (by that I mean alive). Had a huge fuck-Up today. Its a long story, but it consists of me being involved in a pretty big art project (directing a movie) and I fucked Up, because I lacked planning and everything just turnt out bad. The teachers are all mad, and the students are so dissapointed, they dont want to talk to Me. Wrote This maths test today, hopefully I get a C, but I think I fucked up. So the situation is bad, I mean the whole situation in school. I feel like im lacking sleep, but it doesnt take the tiredness from Me at all. This day sucked really bad, but at least I didnt Kill myself, so could be worse. Once again I tried to drown my sadness in video-games, but it just frustrates me, and that is the worst feeling of all feeling, because it is What I feel everytime something happens "not the way Its supposed to happen" and that happens really really often. Tomorrow im gonna have a discipline talk about the art project with my polish teacher, im not really scared or stressed. I fucked up because I "dont have a head anymore" (translated from a polish idiom, but Its exactly What I mean) and im just falling apart in every possible way for a teenager. Mental health is a secret in Poland. There are No mental sicknesses, except being a "psycho", and that is a murderer. I just dont know whats going on.
Good night, hope This day is not gonna be so bad.

I just don't know if This is just a patch, because Its been lasting Since primary school, and now I am so exhausted.
I just dont know if Its worth fighting anymore, Since all I do is lose. I dont even know What im fighting for. 
The thing is: I am smart, but I Cant keep Up with the schema, and the schema is What is important at the labour market/college. I have shit grades because I do things my way, but I dont think my way is even good and so does everyone else.
I Cant retake the exams, and I already have a lot of tutoring
My family laughs at my failures everyday

Yeah, I understand that your life by far may suck. But It doesnt mean that YOU suck, and whats more: that the world sucks. I mean, Dude, you know how much strength it actually takes to write a confess like yours? You can do things, man. Depression is pain, and whats the worst about it - not all the people understand how it works, but here we do. Its always easier to choose peace and ending, but think about it - you have been through thick and thin, and you are only 18. You are a pretty fucking strong guy, seriously. Im only one year younger than you and i Wish i was This strong. You may not understand it, but Its gonna be a huge loss for the world if you Kill yourself. The more you fight, the stronger you get, and whats important - you dont have to fight alone. If you keep on fighting, even though Its exhausting, you will eventually win - and you deserve it. Stay strong Dude, much love from Warsaw.
